fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant is reached by a paved access driveway from Sycamore St; the entrance is an open drive with a wide paved apron and no barrier arm, sliding gate or checkpoint structure at the property line. Classified false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance in 2024-07 Street View or in z18-z20 satellite — the entrance apron is open paved area with no 1-3-vehicle structure beside the lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town setting — the plant sits in an industrial pocket on the NE edge of Manteno surrounded by farm fields and a canal; classified Rural.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard on the NE side of the plant holds ~12-16 trailers on a sand/gravel apron; estimated capacity ~35-40.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open entrance apron and a large unfenced paved yard give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~22 doors along the NW dock bank; imprecise from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing plant plus a smaller co-located building to the SE.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Edge-of-town but Manteno township is built up nearby and the I-57 corridor is close; cellular coverage likely adequate — false, but flagged low-confidence.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large interior paved yard / loop road provides holding room inside the property before docks.
